DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.label: the dream's gift
DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.description: Last night, more than one of us dreamed the same dream. In it, someone left a gift behind - and not one of us can remember what that person looked like.

li.label: Accept the gift
li.description: The dream has already come looking for us. There is no harm in seeing what it wanted to leave behind.

li.label: Refuse
li.description: Treat it as an ordinary dream. When everyone wakes, nothing has changed.

DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.label: warrior from afar
DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.description: A dust-covered stranger has come to the outpost. He says nothing about his past, and asks only whether the tavern still has a place for him.

li.label: Invite him in
li.description: Make a place for this stranger. Perhaps he will tell his story some other time.

li.label: Politely decline
li.description: There is no spare place here for the moment. He nods, then walks back out into the wasteland.
